AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES- draft
  January 25, 2012
  7:00 P.M.

NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the
Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to
5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City
Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626)
812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at
213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California

Call To Order

Chairperson Kindred called the meeting to order at 7:01 p.m.

Pledge of Allegiance

Commissioner Lee led the flag salute.

Roll Call

Members present:  AVILA, LEE, KINDRED, DONNELSON
Members Absent:  MILLNER

Approval of Minutes

None

Staff Present

Director of Economic and Community Development, Kurt Christiansen; Senior Planner, Susan
Cole; and Planning Technician, Graciela Acosta.

Public Participation

Mike Lee and Art Morales spoke.
 PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES -draft

None

Reports and Communications

1.  Update to Planning Commission on Tentative Tract Map TTM 71774, Design
  Review DR 2011-18, Variance V 2011-06 and V 2011-07 (Approved at January 11,
  2012, Planning Commission meeting).

Mr. Christiansen introduced Ms. Cole and she gave the staff presentation update, discussion by
the Commission followed. Mr. McReynolds and Ms. Rapista, applicant’s representatives were
present. He addressed public comments from last meeting when item was approved and
answered questions of the Commission. Mr. Rosales spoke.

2.  Staff update from the City Council meeting.
Mr. Christiansen gave an overview on repercussions to the City from the elimination of the
City’s Redevelopment Agency and provided an update on actions taken at last City Council
meeting.

Discussion Items from the Planning Commission

Commissioner Avila discussed upcoming events.

Adjournment

The Commission voted unanimously to adjourn at 8:02 p.m.
The next regularly scheduled Planning Commission meeting is February 15, 2012.
